construction: A sampled letter mask becomes discrete lamps, each with housing and a hot core.
motion: Fixed lettering; travelling lamp groups and scan rows. The dim state is an intentional low-exposure partner.
reference_device: All Of The Lights 88.5 s: lit and dim dot letters coexist.
reuse: Arbitrary supported font text; best at 3–8 characters. The travelling bands are spatial groups, not semantic letter segmentation.

construction: A letter mask is divided into horizontal slats or vertical comb lines; selected slices shift independently.
motion: Stepped row displacement; geometry remains registered apart from the intended split.
reference_device: All Of The Lights 89.5, 98.5 and 115 s: interlaced and sliced type.
reuse: Short uppercase words; thin combs require checking after video compression.

construction: Compound contours and hand-drawn feather paths share the lettering's side anchors.
motion: Material switches; no whole-card camera motion.
reference_device: All Of The Lights 114.833–114.917 s: a small winged tube sign.
reuse: 3–6 letters work best. The wing roots use the designed word box; unusual side bearings need optical correction.

construction: Nested letter contours converge toward a displaced vanishing point.
motion: Interior depth layers advance on twos while the largest outline stays fixed; state changes alter density and material.
reference_device: All Of The Lights 96.333–96.583 s: receding word outlines.
reuse: 3–8 uppercase letters. The foreground word is intentionally broad.

construction: Original full A–Z monoline skeleton, sheared and repeated as conductors.
motion: Material and conductor changes; shards extend from letter positions.
reference_device: All Of The Lights 94.5 and 99.5 s: elongated angular strokes and shards.
reuse: Uppercase A–Z and spaces; 4–10 letters. This is a custom alphabet, not a downloadable typeface.

construction: A two-line italic serif sign with knockout lettering, bent rails, lamp diamonds and a baseline curl.
motion: Border lamp chase plus enamel/outline material changes.
reference_device: All Of The Lights 109.333–109.583 s: ornate serif lettering over a dense light field.
reuse: One or two words. Longer two-word phrases need optical spacing; no fixed word is silently appended.

construction: Segmented projected circles pass behind and in front of opaque lettering.
motion: Counter-rotating ring segments, dot lettering and a sparse dial state.
reference_device: All Of The Lights 110.833–111.083 s: ring and dotted-letter variants.
reuse: 3–7 letters. Still an exploratory family; depth and word contrast need judging in motion.

construction: Broad solid letterforms use split colour fields, negative space and nested clipped contours.
motion: Hard state changes; deliberately quiet inside each state.
reference_device: All Of The Lights 116.5 s: simple geometric shapes and split fills.
reuse: 2–5 letters. This is a font-based counterform treatment, distinct from the custom modular alphabet.

construction: Blackletter with engraved hatching, a foil gradient, coloured initial and a fine seal.
reference_device: Extends the Enter the Void blackletter feasibility study; the seal and engraving are original.
reuse: Mixed case typically reads better than all caps; 4–9 letters. Decorative seal stays secondary.

construction: Oversized slab lettering, halftone holes, offset printing plates and a textured paper field.
motion: Registration and ink/paper switches; the poster crop remains fixed.
reference_device: An original contrast family developed from the earlier dense-poster study.
reuse: 3–7 letters; edge cropping is intentional. Do not use when complete word readability is required.

construction: Italic solid letters receive layered extrusion, a sharp reflection horizon and a mirrored lower image.
motion: Material switches; one state displaces the reflection horizon.
reference_device: All Of The Lights 106.5 s: small reflective lettering; also extends v003 chrome.
reuse: 3–7 letters. A deliberately familiar chrome treatment, not claimed as a new alphabet.

construction: Three unlike typographic treatments overlap, or a giant initial supports a thin word.
motion: Composition switches between stacked voices, giant ground and thin echoes.
reference_device: All Of The Lights 111.5 and 113 s: giant glyph plus outline and repeated overlapping words.
reuse: 2–6 letters. Overlap is intentional; this family is a composition device.

construction: An original connected Wild logotype or uppercase skeleton becomes glass tubing with a dark jacket, hot core and electrode caps.
motion: Cold glass, coloured gas chase and individual dark electrodes.
reference_device: Original extension of the wire alphabet, informed by the references' emissive lettering.
reuse: Uppercase A–Z and spaces; 3–7 letters. Straight skeleton corners remain visibly engineered.
drawn_word: Wild: an original cubic-path logotype, available in addition to the generic uppercase alphabet.

construction: A tilted sign facade combines slab letters, bulbs placed on distance ridges, an extruded edge, fan rails and a chasing perimeter.
motion: Independent bulb and border chase; dark housing and cut-glass states.
reference_device: All Of The Lights 97 and 107 s: bulb lettering and sign architecture; no reference sign/logo is copied.
reuse: 4–8 uppercase letters. Lamp placement is sampled from the whole letter mask.

construction: Original skeleton strokes are built from overlapping faceted strips and triangular folds.
motion: Material switching; the prismatic state changes facets along the strips.
reference_device: Original construction added to broaden the set beyond illuminated typography.
reuse: Uppercase A–Z and spaces; 3–7 letters. Some complex glyph intersections remain an optical-design task.
drawn_word: Wild: an original cubic-path logotype, available in addition to the generic uppercase alphabet.

construction: A custom A–Z occupancy alphabet is assembled from square and quarter-circle modules.
motion: Tile colour and two-plane weave change while the occupied letter cells stay fixed.
reference_device: Original geometric family, inspired by the references' variety rather than a particular card.
reuse: Uppercase A–Z and spaces; 3–8 letters. This alphabet intentionally has a coarse, playful rhythm.

construction: Original Wild lettering or a rounded alphabet mask is shaded from a cached distance field into curved metallic or resin surfaces.
motion: Analytic reflection and interference phases; no 3D camera or generated footage.
reference_device: Original material experiment; see SURFACE-NOTES.md for method and limitations.
reuse: Uppercase A–Z and spaces. This is a 2D surface approximation; reflective artifacts and long-word fit need screening.
drawn_word: Wild: an original cubic-path logotype, available in addition to the generic uppercase alphabet.
